family.description: Invoker ruling of 2026-10-28: the probed tuned arm alone records batch fill as descriptive evidence, with no comparison or ledger reservation; confirmation verdicts stand and the record pins the probed arm's own digest. Each cell of the frozen FI-2 pilot plan absent from the confirmation plan runs as 5 replicate cells whose baseline and candidate are the probed tuned arm, each dispatched once in the runner's validation position; every execution reports conversion.batch_fill_ns from the arm's zero-iteration stage probe. Validation dispatches open no ledger, so ledger_path names a file the record never writes.

effect.rationale: Ten percent whole-call improvement is material for this integrated route; the canonical freezer requires the margin above one plus the pilot resolution.
effect.equivalence_rationale: At most five percent regression is admissible. The canonical freezer stops if pilot resolution invalidates this margin; no result widens it.
effect.material_gap_rationale: The family has no comparator-gap cell.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: Zero added source lines and zero unsafe kernels: the family measures committed arms under the committed envelope, and its outcome retains or withdraws that envelope's decode selectors.
